title: The Provincial Indemnity Audit
logline: An independent auditor escorts a diplomatic disaster envoy across three star systems, discovering that provincial governors are systematically pocketing reconstruction indemnities owed to merchant families displaced by a naval munitions explosion.

roles.description: Appointed arbitrator for the regional armistice claims commission; proud, weary, and determined to see relief delivered.
High archon of the regional treaty league; patrician, arrogant, and diverting public indemnities into private fleets.
Elected spokesperson for three hundred bankrupt trading families living in transit hulks.
A lavishly appointed private security frigate sent to interdict regional audit missions.
The administrative treaty hub where regional war reparations and disaster funds are managed.
The shattered orbital market station in a neighbouring system where hundreds died during the munitions accident.
The confederation of system governors who control the regional transit gates and indemnity funds.

public_situation: Regional treaty governors announce procedural delays in disbursing multi-million reconstruction funds to merchants displaced by an orbital munitions disaster.
private_truth: The provincial governors have been diverting the indemnity gold into their own private security accounts while falsely blaming customs gridlock.

beats.public_change: Displaced merchants picket outside {role:armistice_claims_rotunda} as regional governors cite administrative audit discrepancies.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to collect an unredacted financial dispatch ledger from a secure municipal vault before provincial auditors overwrite the records.
missions.private_fact: The ledger shows seventy percent of the emergency disaster allocation was converted into private bearer bonds six months ago.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to courier certified refugee family survivor petitions to the central registry to legally block the fund closure.
missions.private_fact: Her elderly parents are currently stranded in unheated transit barracks because the promised housing stipend was never paid.

beats.public_change: Provincial security pickets shadow the audit envoy across the border gateway, citing travel pass irregularities.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to destroy an unregistered private corsair and recover its encrypted encrypted orders proving the ambush was commissioned by {role:provincial_governor_archon}.
missions.private_fact: He realizes the archon will execute anyone carrying physical audit proofs beyond the system boundary.

beats.public_change: Emergency aid warehouses at {role:blasted_market_derelict} are sealed by private bailiffs citing structural contamination.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to scan the disaster site's automated intake docks to verify that reconstruction materials were never delivered despite being logged as paid.
missions.private_fact: The archon's cousin owns the salvage company that collected millions to clear debris that still clogs the docks.

beats.public_change: {role:governor_flagship_frigate} blocks the jump gate approach to the regional supreme court, training laser batteries on the envoy's ship.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to disable the archon's flagship frigate before it destroys the audit transport and purges all financial records.
missions.private_fact: The archon hails mid-combat offering a fortune in bearer securities if the pilot vents the financial ledgers into the gate vortex.

player_choice.prompt: With the archon's frigate disabled and the financial audit verified across three systems, the pilot must decide whether to deliver the charges to the regional supreme court, broker a quiet political restitution pact, or pocket the archon's immense bribe.

options.label: Deliver the unredacted audit to the supreme court to force the arrest of the corrupt provincial governors
Force the archon to secretly release the relief funds directly to the merchant trust in exchange for dropping charges
Vent the audit ledgers and claim the archon's multi-million bearer securities

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the audit to the regional supreme court.
resolutions.summary: The court orders the immediate arrest of {role:provincial_governor_archon}. Stolen funds are returned, and hundreds of merchant families rebuild their livelihoods.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed corrupt system governors who looted disaster indemnities meant for displaced merchants.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a quiet restitution agreement with the archon.
resolutions.summary: {role:provincial_governor_archon} quietly disburses the funds to avoid prosecution. The families are housed, while political stability across the league is preserved.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot forced an aristocratic governor to quietly release disaster relief funds to displaced merchant families.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the archon's bribe and vents the records.
resolutions.summary: {role:provincial_governor_archon} purges the claims docket. Displaced merchants are evicted from barracks into debtor camps, while the pilot secures vast wealth.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot took a bribe to destroy evidence of corrupt governors stealing regional disaster relief.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the defense.
resolutions.summary: Private security ships destroy the audit vessel in deep transit. The claims are dismissed, leaving the displaced merchants scattered into servitude.

loose_threads.detail: A regional commodities bank records private bearer bond liquidations issued against disaster relief accounts two days before the explosion inquiry closed.
The rebuilding convoy bills of lading describe automated cargo barges that were scrapped in a drydock five years prior to the contract date.

radio_hooks: Regional armistice commission delays disaster restitution payouts citing cross-border audit reviews.
Displaced merchant families stage demonstrations outside provincial gate clearance hubs.
Provincial treaty governors assure public that emergency rebuilding funds remain fully secured.

voice_direction.diplomatic_envoy: Formal, measured, and speaks with weary bureaucratic dignity. Pauses to suppress rising indignation when confronting provincial arrogance.
voice_direction.provincial_governor_archon: Languid, patrician, and speaks with icy condescension. Treats displaced merchants purely as an aesthetic nuisance.
voice_direction.displaced_merchants_trustee: Strained, urgent, and speaks with fierce maternal protection. Refuses to be intimidated by aristocratic titles.
